description: Deploy PgBouncer in transaction-pooling mode in front of a PostgreSQL 16 primary database serving 50 application servers. Each app server currently maintains 50-100 persistent connections, causing excessive connection churn and memory pressure. Target: pool of 200 connections total. Must deploy PgBouncer on dedicated instances (2-node HA) with zero downtime. DNS-based cutover from direct connections to PgBouncer. Risk factors: prepared statement handling differences in transaction mode, apps using SET session parameters, LISTEN/NOTIFY incompatibility, and increased latency from an additional network hop. Verify connection counts drop and query latency stays within 5% of baseline. Tools available: HAProxy, Consul DNS, PgBouncer stats, pgbadger, application config management.
